operations.name: Hakim Nasir al-Zujaji
operations.description: a bodiless alchemist of Aleppo who lives in the vapour of his own stills and keeps glassblowers the way other men keep bees; he owned me for a hundred years

operations.name: Humans are Cattle
operations.description: I count a crowd the way my father counted cords of beechwood for the furnace

operations.name: The Pelican of Aleppo
operations.description: a double-necked alembic of my own blowing, in which I distilled a hundred and nine men down to a spoonful of black salt for my master

operations.text: Hakim Nasir al-Zujaji takes me off the Aleppo road with my crate of cristallo and keeps me a hundred years at his stills, and every night of her life Sabiha bint Yusuf leaves bread at the cellar door without once asking what I eat; I buy my way out by blowing The Pelican of Aleppo with a flaw at the neck no thicker than a hair, and by the time his vapour goes out of it into the souk she and her grandchildren are long under the dust.
